sections.section_title: OTG device IN endpoint transmit FIFO status register (OTG_DTXFSTSx)
sections.text_helper: Section 73.14.52 "OTG device IN endpoint transmit FIFO status register (OTG_DTXFSTSx)" in chapter 73 (USB on-the-go high-speed (OTG)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3849.
sections.section_content:
This read-only register contains the free space information for the device IN endpoint Tx
FIFO.
Address offset: 0x918 + 0x20 * x, (x = 0 to 8)
Reset value: 0x00000200
Bits 31:16 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 15:0 INEPTFSAV[15:0]: IN endpoint Tx FIFO space available
Indicates the amount of free space available in the endpoint Tx FIFO.
Values are in terms of 32-bit words:
0x0: Endpoint Tx FIFO is full
0x1: 1 word available
0x2: 2 words available
0xn: n words available
Others: Reserved

fields.name: Res.
fields.description: Reserved, must be kept at reset value.

fields.name: INEPTFSAV[15:0]
fields.description: IN endpoint Tx FIFO space available Indicates the amount of free space available in the endpoint Tx FIFO. Values are in terms of 32-bit words: 0xn: n words available
